instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: My grandfather’s voice was very monotonous when he talked about his childhood.
atoms.b: My grandfather’s voice was very ((monotonous)) when he talked about his childhood.

atoms.a: The new kitchen in their office is very spacious.
atoms.b: The new kitchen in their office is very ((spacious)).

atoms.a: The coach was incredulous that he again didn’t show up to practice.
atoms.b: The coach was ((incredulous)) that he again didn’t show up to practice.

atoms.a: After a long and vigorous discussion, they finally found a compromise.
atoms.b: After a long and ((vigorous)) discussion, they finally found a compromise.

atoms.a: The detective followed an anonymous tip.
The more he told me about his motives, the more suspicious I got.
atoms.b: The more he told me about his motives, the more ((suspicious)) I got.
